column1: # PROJECT TEMPLATE CATALOG - the python pack's
# `fnew` reads the catalog of every installed pack and shows each row with the
# pack it was read from; that pack's step runs once the template is copied. A
# row another pack knows what to do with belongs in that pack's catalog.
# One template per line:  <url> <TAB> <tool> <TAB> <version> <TAB> <description>
#   url         anything copier or ccds accepts (gh: shorthand or full URL).
#               A cruft row needs the full https:// address: cruft hands the
#               string to git, which does not know gh:.
#   tool        copier | cruft | ccds   (dispatches to the matching gmake target)
#   version     optional pinned ref/tag (e.g. v1); empty for the default
#   description shown in the fnew picker
# An entry belongs here when a checkable fact justifies it - the project is
# maintained, its CI scaffolds one - and that fact goes in the description.
# Nothing here suits you? You do not need an entry:
#   fnew gh:owner/repo [copier|cruft|ccds]      # reads and writes nothing
# and if it earns its place, append a line - TABs, not spaces, or the picker
# ignores the row (it says so on stderr when it does).
